a-socio: Stands for a socio (the product's word for an AI agent) whose name isn't known, or when several socios could be answering.
you: Above the reader's own messages in a room, where other messages show their writer's name.
status: Line under the room's title in its header, once the reader is no longer in it. "Room" is a product noun: a conversation several people and a socio share.
pinned: Header button that opens the room's pinned facts and notes. Hidden visually on narrow phones, still read by screen readers.
members: Header button that opens the room's Members panel (its people and socios).
empty: Note in a room with no messages yet.
reading: Under a message just sent, while the socio picks it up; name is the socio's name.
queued.next: Under a message waiting in the room's queue while the socio works; name is the socio's name. "its" is the socio's (an AI agent).
queued.later: Under a waiting message that the socio reads only after its whole reply; name is the socio's name.
queued.others: Under another person's waiting message, which a room admin sees; name is the socio's name.
archived.notice: Notice above an archived room, which is read-only.
archived.unarchive: Button in the archived notice, for the room's admins; it brings the room back.
composer.label: Accessible name of the room's message box.
composer.placeholder: Placeholder of the room's message box when one socio answers; name is that socio's name, shortened if long. Keep it short: it must fit on one line on a phone.
composer.placeholder-several: Placeholder when several socios answer: the writer may @mention one. Keep it short.
composer.placeholder-admin: Placeholder for a room admin when one socio answers; name is the socio's name. /invite is a typed command: don't translate it.
composer.placeholder-admin-several: Placeholder for a room admin when several socios answer. /invite is a typed command: don't translate it.
composer.to-targets: Under the message box: who the message will go to; targets is the socios' names, already joined into a list.
composer.to-lead: Under the message box when several socios are in the room and none is named; name is the lead socio's name.
composer.waits: Under the message box while the socio is working: a new message waits in the queue.
composer.everyone: Under the message box when one socio answers.
composer.stop: Accessible name of the button that stops the socio's running answer.
composer.stop-title: Tooltip of the stop button: a person may stop their own answer, and a room admin anyone's.
composer.queue: Accessible name of the send button while the socio is working: the message waits in the queue.
composer.send: Accessible name of the room's send button while no socio is working.
speaker.socio: Small tag beside a socio's name above its message, so it reads apart from people's names. "socio" is the product's word for an AI agent.
speaker.team-member: Stands for the writer of an old message stored before writers were recorded.
mentions.list: Accessible name of the @mention list over the message box.
mentions.socio: Small tag beside a socio in the @mention list.
mentions.socio-lead: Small tag beside the room's lead socio in the @mention list.
mentions.people: Part of the screen-reader line saying how many match an @mention; count is how many people.
mentions.socios: Part of the screen-reader line saying how many match an @mention; count is how many socios.
mentions.status: Screen-reader line as the @mention list opens; parts is the counts (mentions.people, mentions.socios) as a list.
mentions.you: Small tag beside a message's writer when the message mentions the reader: an "@" icon comes before it, so it reads "@ you".
mentions.you-sr: What screen readers say for that tag.
presence.here: Header line of who else is looking at the room now; names is their names, as a list.
presence.more: The same with more than two people: first and second are two names, count is how many more.
topic.status: Line under the title of a team conversation from a Telegram topic, which is read-only here.
topic.empty: In a Telegram team conversation (read-only here) when it has no messages yet.
topic.reply: Note under a Telegram team conversation: people answer it in Telegram.
topic.convert: Link-styled button after that note: makes the Telegram topic a room. "Room" is a product noun.
usage.limits: A room's limits for each message's work, in its Members panel; parts is a list (usage.work, usage.tokens, usage.handoffs, usage.spend-limit), perMinute is usage.per-minute and waiting is usage.waiting.
usage.work: Part of usage.limits; time is a duration, already formatted (for example "10m").
usage.tokens: How many tokens (units of model text); count is the number.
usage.handoffs: How many handoffs (one socio passing the work to another) a message may make.
usage.spend-limit: Part of usage.limits; amount is a price, already formatted.
usage.per-minute: How many messages a person may send a minute.
usage.waiting: How many messages may wait in the queue at most; n is the number.
usage.tokens-of: Tokens a message used of its limit; used is usage.tokens, limit the limit.
usage.time-of: Time a message worked of its limit; elapsed and limit are durations, already formatted.
usage.handoffs-of: Handoffs a message made of its limit.
usage.spend: What a message cost; amount is a price, already formatted.
usage.spend-of: What a message cost of its limit; amount and limit are prices, already formatted.
usage.spend-private: A message's cost isn't shown: it ran on its sender's own model subscription.
usage.spend-unknown: In the usage section of the Members panel: the model didn't report what the message cost.
usage.stopped: Which limit stopped a message's work; the context forms name the limit.
usage.messages: How many messages the socio worked on.
usage.day: The room's total for the last day; messages is usage.messages, tokens is usage.tokens.
usage.day-stopped: The same, with how many messages a limit stopped.
usage.day-hidden: Shown instead of the day's total while too few people have written; n is the smallest number of people.
errors.load-room: Shown when the room's messages couldn't be read.
errors.read-room: Shown when the room's people and socios couldn't be read.
usage.heading.running: Heading over the use of the message the socio works on now, someone else's. The other usage.heading keys are its variants.
usage.heading.running-mine: Heading over the use of the reader's own message, which the socio works on now.
usage.heading.last: Heading over the use of the last message the socio finished, someone else's.
usage.heading.last-mine: Heading over the use of the last message the socio finished, the reader's own.
usage.loading: In the usage section of the Members panel while it loads.
picker.label: Accessible name of the composer's @ button that names a socio (AI agent) to answer.
picker.title: Tooltip of the @ button; "the lead" is the room's default socio.
picker.heading: Heading of the @ button's menu of socios.
picker.lead: Small tag beside the socio that leads the room (answers by default).
invite-command.list: Accessible name of the list the /invite command shows above the message box.
invite-command.count: Said by screen readers: how many people the /invite list shows.
